summary: Ecopetrol S.A. filed a Form 6-K announcing the schedule for its Q2 2026 earnings release and conference call. The earnings will be released on August 3, 2026, with a virtual conference on August 4, 2026. No offer, transaction, or corporate action is disclosed. The filing is a routine earnings announcement by a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a U.S. earnings press release. No special-situation event is present.
